verdict.rationale: Ramp ships its own AI agents (Ramp Intelligence), so letting users connect external MCP servers to them is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only shows Ramp acting as an MCP server: Ramp MCP, Developer MCP and Ramp Data MCP are consumed by assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Nothing shows Ramp acting as an MCP client that can register external MCP servers and use their tools, and server-side MCP evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.
